description: Night-black, small lights all through it, pale seams branching over it that open into nothing. Lighter than it should be.
lore: Handlers grade stones by heft in the dark, and this one lies to the hand: night-black, full of small lights at no settled depth, and far too light for what it is. It is the dearest thing the eastern ground gives up, and it is paid for in [[lore/the_gold_agreement|gold]] only — for this one, no seller takes anything that drifts.

It goes into blades and only into blades, and that rule has a name on it. [[characters/54bead23|Osric]], new enough to still count in living years, reasoned that a stone which moves a fighter might move him out of harm's way, and set one into a breastplate. It moved him one stride — into the middle of what he was backing away from. He re-formed beside [[characters/6bb1eb5a|Solveig]]'s fire a night later, short the end of the argument he had been winning, and [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]] pried the stone out of the dented plate, set it in a blade, and hung the plate on her wall where customers can see it.

In a blade, where it belongs, blows land heavy and dark, and once in a while the fight turns and you are standing on the far side of it, facing a back — the side [[monsters/diablo_2|the Balefiend]] was always on: the one you were not watching.
